notes: Craft: eight scenes because the record's own arc requires the council asymmetry, the three rounds, wisdom's chapter, the oath, two distinct whirlwind movements, and the double ending (humbling + rebuke/intercession) before the return. The whirlwind scenes use the storm palette; the ending scene keeps both the ⚖ rebuke and the named daughters so neither half of ch.42 can be dropped. | E0 correction 2026-09-17: receipt-era sha256 replaced with actual-bytes hash at dbf3b17 (prior value kept as sha256_receipt_stale). E0 acceptance repair: title/field collision fixed on m-job-0-councils, m-job-3-whirlwind, m-job-5-return (title width 560; formations iteratively scaled and dropped clear of the title band); cover re-captured.

#0 councils — the asymmetry of knowledge staged in brightness: the council ring sits dim in the upper field (convening, then darker as the wager is set), Job's world runs bright below and then dims (the man unchanged in his knowing); ⊣ becomes ☠ — the wager's challenge becomes the losses the reader watches; pointer repel faint — what Job cannot reach.

#1 rounds — line layout: Eliphaz, Bildad, Zophar in their column; Eliphaz's sign becomes ⚖ and steps toward Job (the moral order invoked as accusation); Job carries a small repel field (answers, protests); pointer shove — explanation adding injury.
#2 wisdom — the shaft descends: the square narrows and sinks while ⛏ follows it down; the ore disc dims — gold cannot purchase; pointer attract faint — the search itself.

#2b oath — the demanded charge ≡+ becomes the written ✍ (the demand staged as the sign's own act); ☁ grows and darkens twice — the weather displacing the courtroom; pointer repel — the contest held open.

#3 whirlwind — THE 3D SCENE. z is the whirlwind's depth: the answer's ring opens from small to large at depth (the storm's mouth), the hawk 𓅃 crosses from high z +0.4 to deep z −0.2 (the creatures' reaches), the sea's disc breaks into a ring (the womb opened, doors and bars) — vortex3d drives a real storm circulation; saw-wave turbulence LFO (the wind's drive); pointer vortex with shove click; duration 16 — the speech held.

#3b behemoth — the coil that cannot be drawn: Leviathan's ring widens and deepens (no hook draws him out — the ring grows but holds); ⚔ becomes ♛ (the counted weapons become the majesty Job would need to administer); pointer repel with vortex click — displayed, unseizable.

#4 return — grid layout: the household restored; ◉ brightens twice its size (report become sight — the book's turn); ⚖ becomes ✋ (the friends' restoration passing through Job's interceding hand); pointer attract — the intercession.

#5→0 essay return — the appointment cards settle beside 1/0; circulation breathes on a slow sine (auto-terminal); pointer near-still. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 opened with knowledge asymmetric — the reader saw councils Job could not; #5→0 makes the account's own councils addressable (C27, A24, A29 as carriers now exposed rather than hidden), and the ? of #0 is answered not by explanation but by the 1/0 return — encounter beyond the ear. The storms of #3–#3b stay dark in the palette's memory while the human scenes keep their parchment: the losses are retained in the material as in the text.

Human-amplified staging (binding flags kept): Jung's Answer to Job carried as a second, attributed whole in the #4 body — distinct registers, not additional speeches; the native eightfold named without biblical derivation in #5→0. Mythemic verbs only: the narrative demonstrates the protected account; the whirlwind demonstrates the extent of the question — no formal entailment, no QL derivation attributed to the text.

Automation: auto-storm (turbulence, saw — the whirlwind's drive) and auto-terminal (circulation, sine — the return's breath). Durations 11–16, transitions 1.1–2.2: the whirlwind held longest, the oath shortest.

glyph_rationales.·: the unnamed carrier — a formation whose sense is its shape alone (the council ring, the shaft, the sea, Leviathan's coil); no glyph is pretended.
glyph_rationales.?: the integrity question — "Doth Job fear God for nought?" — the wager that precedes the suffering (#0).
glyph_rationales.Job: the witness whose integrity the opening affirmed — the man the explanation-account must confront (chs. 1–2).
glyph_rationales.⊣: the adversary's challenge: the wager set — remove the hedge and he will curse (Job 1).
glyph_rationales.☠: the losses: servants, children, livestock — deaths the reader watches and Job does not understand (#0).
glyph_rationales.E1: Eliphaz: the first round — from Job's former strength to the innocency question (chs. 4–5).
glyph_rationales.B: Bildad: divine justice insisted — the children's death explicable through transgression (ch. 8).
glyph_rationales.Z: Zophar: the intensified accusation — wisdom not the friends' possession (ch. 11).
glyph_rationales.⚖: the disputed justice: the moral order the friends invoke and the criterion ch. 28 and ch. 38 overturn.
glyph_rationales.✎: Job's protest: the oath-bound claim and the demand for a hearing (chs. 23, 31).
glyph_rationales.⛏: the miner: human skill opening shafts, bringing hidden ore to light (ch. 28).
glyph_rationales.≡: the hidden ordering of things — wind, water, rain, thunder — which God knows and the miner cannot reach (ch. 28).
glyph_rationales.✍: the written charge: what Job asks of the adversary — carried openly on the shoulder, as a crown (ch. 31).
glyph_rationales.≡+: the adversary's answer demanded in a contestable form — the oath naming the relations under which innocence could be examined (ch. 31).
glyph_rationales.Eh: Elihu: suffering as instruction — heard in tension; absent from the named rebuke in 42 (chs. 32–37).
glyph_rationales.☁: the gathering weather: the storm that begins to displace the imagined courtroom (chs. 36–37, into 38).
glyph_rationales.𓅃: the hawk and the wild creatures: need and predation within an order that does not serve Job's household (ch. 39).
glyph_rationales.✋: the hand on the mouth (40:3–5) and, at the return, the interceding hand — Job's prayer consequential for his friends.
glyph_rationales.♛: the majesty Job would need to administer judgement: "clothe himself in majesty" — the challenge of the second speech (chs. 40–41).
glyph_rationales.⚔: the counted weapons — stubble before Leviathan: capture failing in every human practice (ch. 41).
glyph_rationales.◉: the eye that sees: "now mine eye seeth thee" — report become encounter (ch. 42).
glyph_rationales.⁂: the named daughters — Jemima, Kezia, Keren-happuch — given inheritance among their brothers (ch. 42).
glyph_rationales.C27: the Protected Account's criterion: can the witness alter the authority of the account under which the witness is received? (the essay's appointment).
glyph_rationales.A24: arbitration and the usurpation of measure: a criterion becoming usurping when its relation to the field can no longer be questioned.
glyph_rationales.A23: trust under formal limit: address persisting after its first account of safety fails (C48).
glyph_rationales.A29: power, delegated labour and return: the council's permissions and the losses borne below — where consequence can arrive.
glyph_rationales.1/0: the terminal movement of the native field: the achieved determination returned toward its ground — no biblical derivation claimed (essay return).
